crossRefs.note: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous, because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished…
For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners…

translations.web: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
translations.bsb: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
